d: The Category Manager Assistant supports the Category Manager in executing strategies for product selection, pricing, promotions, and inventory management within the grocery e-commerce dark store operations. This role requires keen market awareness, data analysis skills, and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally to optimize category performance and ensure product availability aligns with customer demand.
q: Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
1–3 years of experience in category management, merchandising, or retail operations, preferably in the grocery or e-commerce industry.
Familiarity with supplier coordination and inventory management.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint) and data analysis tools.
Experience with e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems is a plus.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

r: Support the implementation of category plans and strategies to drive sales growth, enhance product assortment, and improve market positioning.
Collaborate with the Category Manager to select products, manage product lifecycle, and execute merchandising strategies for optimal online presentation.
Assist in managing supplier relationships, coordinating product orders, and ensuring timely deliveries to maintain stock levels.
Contribute to the development and execution of pricing strategies and promotional campaigns to boost sales and improve category margins.
Monitor stock levels and coordinate with supply chain teams to prevent stockouts and overstock situations.
Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify trends, consumer needs, and opportunities for category expansion.
Analyse sales data, track performance metrics, and generate reports to support decision-making and strategy adjustments.
Work closely with marketing, supply chain, and operations teams to ensure product availability, timely promotions, and a seamless customer experience.
Ensure accurate and engaging product descriptions, images, and specifications are maintained on the e-commerce platform.
